title: Getting the units right
summary: rad/s to rotations per second to volts to duty cycle.

steps.title: A chain of conversions
steps.say: The target is in radians per second, kV wants rotations per second, and the motor wants a duty cycle.

board.code:
double rps = CONSTANTS.SHOOT_VELOCITY / (2 * Math.PI);   // rad/s -> rotations/s
double volts = CONSTANTS.FLYWHEEL_KV * rps;              // what it takes to hold that speed
double duty = volts / 12.0;                              // a fraction of the battery

steps.title: Half of robot programming
steps.say: A wrong unit doesn't crash: it just makes the robot do the wrong thing. Write the unit next to every number you can.
